text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Rob Roy!
This seat next to you is free, right?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ah... S-Sweep-san.
Here, go ahead...!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"I heard about the Tenno Sho (Autumn).
You won, didn't you?"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Even in the next Japan Cup... I don't intend to let anyone else take the win.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...Hmm, I see.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"U-Um, Sweep-san!
May I... ask something as well?"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: What is it?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
You mentioned it in an interview before, right?
That in your Classic year, you'd run
the Triple Tiara route—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: In the Senior Class, she aims to race against competitors from the Triple Crown route and claim victory over them.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: "With that... I'll cast the magic of racing across the entire world, you say?"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Have you already decided... on which 'race to cast your magic' in...?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Hmm, right. I was thinking of just deciding it myself, but—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: You decide, familiar.
In the Hanshin JF, in the Triple Tiara, and now this Queen Elizabeth II Cup—

"Even though she sought my advice,
in the end, she was always the one who chose her races. That was—"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: It's fine! You're the one who decides!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: "Besides, being your consultation partner was months ago!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
So you're saying that as a familiar,
you haven't grown at aaaaall?
That you haven't been working hard?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: That is NOT what I meant!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
If you get it, then start thinking already.
...Ah, but make sure you watch today's
Queen Elizabeth II Cup closely, okay?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Watch closely as I become the representative of all the Umamusume on the Triple Tiara route, and decide after that.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Where should the stage be to change the world?!
